[007]    │> Select shared-context projects through interactive breadcrumbs · Description                                                     │
[008]    │ ## What to build                                                                                                                  │
[009]    │                                                                                                                                   │
[010]  Wa│ Add the Projects view to the shared-context modal. Users open this view through a focusable, clickable Projects breadcrumb. Users │
[011]  '/│ select a project and browse its existing tracker and Files workspace.                                                             │
[012]    │                                                                                                                                   │
[013] ───│ Reuse shared-context enumeration and route resolution. Include the current project. Deduplicate entries by canonical identity. Do │────
[014]  Up│ not scan unrelated repositories or add another project registry.                                                                  │
[015]  Ne│                                                                                                                                   │
[016] ───│ Establish the breadcrumb and focus contract for later tracker screens. The current command still opens the current project.       │────
[017]    │ Selecting another project changes only the modal context.                                                                         │
[018] ───│                                                                                                                                   │ ⟲ ─
[019] ❯  │ ## Acceptance criteria                                                                                                            │
[020] ───│                                                                                                                                   │────
[021]  ◑ │ 1. The project list displays a name and origin or stable identity for each project. Equal repository names remain distinguishable.│
[022]    │ 2. Keyboard focus reaches the Projects breadcrumb. Enter activates it. A mouse click activates the same control.                  │
[023]    │ 3. Selecting a project resolves its routes before record access. The selected project owns tracker reads, Files reads, and action │
[024]    │ targets.                                                                                                                          │
[025]    │ 4. The header displays Shared or Repo from the selected alignment route. The indicator is read-only.                              │
[026]    │ 5. Project selection does not change the active Pi session directory or system instructions.                                      │
[027]    │ 6. Returning to a project restores its navigation, selection, and scroll position. Each workspace retains independent state.      │
[028]    │ 7. Project changes dispose of old watchers and attach the correct new watchers. Old project updates do not change the selected    │
[029]    │ project view.                                                                                                                     │
[030]    │ 8. A project without a usable checkout retains readable context. Checkout-dependent actions display a clear disabled reason.      │
[031]    │ 9. No action runs against the previous project after selection changes. Existing action revalidation and fresh-chat behavior      │
[032]    │ remain intact.                                                                                                                    │
[033]    │ 10. Tab and Shift+Tab move focus forward and backward. Existing workspace number shortcuts remain unchanged.                      │
[034]    │ 11. Esc from the tracker root opens Projects. Esc from Projects closes the modal. Existing Files escape behavior remains          │
[035]    │ unchanged.                                                                                                                        │
[036]    │ 12. Empty, unreadable, and unavailable project states display distinct explanations. The current project remains reachable.       │
[037]    │                                                                                                                                   │
